source: Production schema definitions confirmed by read-only metadata inspection on 2026-11-18; no business row content

objects.name: idx_business_jobs_created
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_business_jobs_created ON business_jobs(created_at DESC)

objects.name: ai_usage
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE ai_usage (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, purpose TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: business_jobs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE business_jobs (  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  job_type TEXT NOT NULL,  topic TEXT NOT NULL,  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','draft','failed')),  output TEXT,  error TEXT,  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

objects.name: google_oauth_states
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE google_oauth_states (   state TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,   expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

objects.name: google_tokens
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE google_tokens (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),   encrypted_refresh_token TEXT NOT NULL,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,   updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

objects.name: research_cache
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE research_cache (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: research_plans
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE research_plans (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, topic TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: research_requests
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE research_requests (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source TEXT NOT NULL, attempted_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
